points.K10: 监护人不能独自进去救

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一个盖着盖板的检修井旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a covered maintenance hatch with a warning sign and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天十道题，讲讲有限空间。

shots.scene: 一行图标：井口、储罐、风机、气体检测仪
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a manhole, a storage tank, a ventilation blower and a gas detector. No people.
shots.narration: 进去之前，通风、检测、审批、监护。

shots.scene: 实验楼地下室，污水池的检修口打开着
shots.prompt_en: In a laboratory building basement, the hatch of an underground wastewater pit is open.
shots.narration: 实验楼地下的污水池要清理。

shots.scene: 老李拿着工具，准备直接下去
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds tools and leans toward the hatch as if to climb in.
shots.narration: 老李想着下去看一眼就上来。

shots.scene: 王老师拦住他，手里拿着气体检测仪和作业票
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stops him, holding a gas detector and a blank permit form.
shots.narration: 王老师拦住：这是有限空间，按规矩来。

shots.scene: 井、罐、管道、地下池四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a manhole, a tank, a large pipe and an underground pit, each with a narrow opening. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：什么是有限空间？

shots.scene: 狭窄的出入口，一个人形图标侧身才能通过
shots.prompt_en: A narrow opening that a person icon can only pass sideways. No people.
shots.narration: 进出口受限，不是给人长期待的地方。

shots.scene: 开阔的房间图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wide open room crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 开阔空间不算，答案是前两条。

shots.scene: 作业票和印章图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank permit form and a stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：进有限空间要不要审批？

shots.scene: 王老师在作业票上签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs the blank permit beside the hatch.
shots.narration: 国内按规定审批，学校也有制度。

shots.scene: 一本书和图章
shots.prompt_en: A closed blank book with a stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 具体按国家标准和本校规定执行。

shots.scene: 检测仪屏幕上三个图标：氧气、火焰、骷髅
shots.prompt_en: A gas detector display showing three icons: an oxygen symbol, a flame and a skull. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：必须检测哪几类？

shots.scene: 王老师把检测仪探头伸进井口
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator lowers a gas detector probe into the hatch.
shots.narration: 氧含量、可燃气、有毒气，三样都测。

shots.scene: 一个空储罐，罐口敞开
shots.prompt_en: An empty chemical storage tank with its top hatch open. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：空的化学品罐，算不算？

shots.scene: 罐底残留液体冒出淡淡的气
shots.prompt_en: Faint vapor rises from a small residue at the bottom of the tank. No people.
shots.narration: 算！残留物会挥发，氧气也可能不够。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在井口外，手拿对讲机，盯着下面
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands outside the hatch holding a radio, watching inside.
shots.narration: 第五题：监护人要跟着下去吗？

shots.scene: 两个人都下去、上面没人的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two people inside a pit with nobody outside, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要，监护人始终守在外面。

shots.scene: 阿杰和里面保持通话
shots.prompt_en: The young male student talks on the radio with the person inside.
shots.narration: 盯住里面，保持联络，随时报警。

shots.scene: 氧气瓶图标的刻度条，两端都是红色
shots.prompt_en: A gauge bar for oxygen level with red zones at both the low end and the high end and green in the middle. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：氧含量怎样会致命？

shots.scene: 低端红区：人形图标晕倒
shots.prompt_en: In the low red zone, a person icon collapses. No people.
shots.narration: 太少会窒息，几口气就可能倒下。

shots.scene: 高端红区：火焰变旺
shots.prompt_en: In the high red zone, a flame grows larger. No people.
shots.narration: 太多会助燃，遇火源更危险。

shots.scene: 一本书和图章
shots.prompt_en: A closed blank book with a stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 合格范围按国内标准，不照搬原题。

shots.scene: 一名路过的人想下井，被拦住
shots.prompt_en: A passer-by icon tries to climb into the hatch and is stopped by a barrier. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：谁都能进去维修吗？

shots.scene: 老李出示培训合格卡
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer shows a blank training certificate card.
shots.narration: 不行，要经过培训、有能力的人。

shots.scene: 检测仪上氧气图标先亮起
shots.prompt_en: On the gas detector, the oxygen icon lights up first. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：先测什么？

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger.
shots.narration: 先测氧含量，再测可燃和有毒气体。

shots.scene: 可燃气和有毒气图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The flame icon and the skull icon light up in turn on the detector. No people.
shots.narration: 氧不够，其他读数也可能不准。

shots.scene: 检测仪屏幕上出现红色警报
shots.prompt_en: A gas detector screen flashes a red alarm. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：IDLH是什么意思？

shots.scene: 警示三角和心跳线
shots.prompt_en: A warning triangle next to a heartbeat line that drops. No people.
shots.narration: 立即危及生命或健康的浓度。

shots.scene: 人员远离井口的图标
shots.prompt_en: Person icons stepping back from the hatch. No people.
shots.narration: 到了这种程度，绝不能进入。

shots.section_title: 监护人不能独自进去救
shots.scene: 井下的人倒下，阿杰想往下冲
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person collapsed inside a pit while the attendant leans to jump in. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：监护人能独自进去救人吗？
overlay: 监护人不能独自进去救

shots.section_title: 监护人不能独自进去救
shots.scene: 欣欣摇头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head firmly.
shots.narration: 不能，没人接替就下去，会再倒一个。

shots.section_title: 监护人不能独自进去救
shots.scene: 阿杰按下报警，呼叫救援
shots.prompt_en: The young male student presses an alarm and calls for help on the radio.
shots.narration: 先报警呼救，等救援力量。

shots.scene: 井口三个人形图标接连倒下，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of three people collapsing one after another at a pit opening, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 有限空间事故，常是救人的人也倒下。

shots.scene: 用安全绳和三脚架把人从井口拉上来
shots.prompt_en: A tripod with a rescue winch and lifeline pulls a person icon up from the hatch. No people.
shots.narration: 进入前就系好安全绳，在外面拉。

shots.scene: 电话图标120和119
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a medical cross and a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 打120、119，报告保卫处。

shots.scene: 救援人员戴正压呼吸器准备进入
shots.prompt_en: A rescue worker icon wearing a self-contained breathing apparatus prepares to enter. No people.
shots.narration: 只有配齐装备的救援人员才能进。

shots.scene: 检测仪探头分别放在上、中、下三个高度
shots.prompt_en: A gas detector probe sampled at the top, middle and bottom of a pit. No people.
shots.narration: 上中下都要测，气体会分层。

shots.scene: 老李腰上挂着便携检测仪进入
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears a portable gas detector clipped at his chest while working inside.
shots.narration: 作业中持续检测，随身带检测仪。

shots.scene: 检测仪报警，老李立即撤出
shots.prompt_en: The detector alarms and the facility engineer climbs out immediately.
shots.narration: 一报警，立即撤出。

shots.scene: 风机通过软管向井内送风
shots.prompt_en: A blower pushes fresh air into the pit through a yellow duct. No people.
shots.narration: 进入前和作业中，都要机械通风。

shots.scene: 用氧气瓶往井里吹的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an oxygen cylinder blowing into a pit, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 严禁用纯氧通风，会引发火灾。

shots.scene: 过滤式口罩在缺氧环境图标中打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A filter respirator icon inside a low-oxygen zone, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 过滤式口罩只过滤，不能补氧。

shots.scene: 隔绝式呼吸器打勾
shots.prompt_en: A supplied-air respirator icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 缺氧或浓度不明，用隔绝式呼吸器。

shots.scene: 老李在狭窄的池里弯腰作业，满头大汗
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer works bent over in a cramped pit, sweating heavily.
shots.narration: 狭小空间又闷又热，姿势别扭。

shots.scene: 时钟图标和两人交替进出
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon and two workers taking turns entering and resting. No people.
shots.narration: 控制单次作业时间，轮换进出。

shots.scene: 老李出来喝水休息，阿杰递水
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer rests outside and drinks water handed by the young male student.
shots.narration: 出来补水、伸展腰背，再继续。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在井口旁的白板前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard beside the hatch.
shots.narration: 出入受限、不宜久留，就是有限空间。

shots.scene: 风机、检测仪、作业票三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blower, a gas detector and a permit form. No people.
shots.narration: 先通风、再检测、后作业，先审批。

shots.scene: 阿杰守在井口
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands guard at the hatch with a radio.
shots.narration: 监护人守在外面，不独自下去救。

shots.scene: 三脚架和呼吸器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a rescue tripod and a breathing apparatus. No people.
shots.narration: 救援靠装备，不靠勇气。

shots.scene: 欣欣在盖好的井口旁挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside the closed hatch.
shots.narration: 进去之前多想一步，人人平安！
